Entry Smuggling and Embargoes Smuggling doesn't always start out of greed, sometimes it's just too much tax, a port is closed, or a family needs a way to survive. Rulers called it an erosion of order, merchants called it flexibility, and coastal residents knew that boats in the dark could bring danger as well as much-needed salt. Any break in the place of origin, checkpoints, shipping schedules, debts and protection fees will immediately make the nobles in the distance feel the changes in price and power.

Entry Smuggling and Embargoes Smuggling doesn't always start out of greed, sometimes it's just too much tax, a port is closed, or a family needs a way to survive. Rulers called it an erosion of order, merchants called it flexibility, and coastal residents knew that boats in the dark could bring danger as well as much-needed salt. They may not necessarily understand ledgers, but they know the true weight of a bag of salt and a nail on the road.
